texts.name: Quandyxius
texts.biography: Having devoted his life to the study of dragonkind, Quandyxius uncovered secrets of their existence that transcended mortality. Even after embracing necromancy, his fascination with dragons never faded. Under his command, Ghost Dragons become more powerful, guided by the knowledge of one who understands both their living and spectral forms.

specialty.name: Bone Dragons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Bone Dragons or Ghost Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
